# SIMULATED DOCUMENT: written for the OrbitFlow demo. It is not an operator's real procedure.

## 1 Emergency priority
Cells carrying declared emergency or safety-of-life traffic must keep service. They are illuminated in every slot while the declaration is in force, so real-time queues stay within the delay budget.

## 2 Starvation
Priority for emergency cells must not leave any other cell without service for longer than the starvation limit.

## 3 Escalation
When emergency capacity cannot be met within applicable limits, the duty engineer is alerted with the measured capacity shortfall in Mbps.
